paragraphs.text: Laurine is a human rogue hailing from Innistrad . She and her partner Kamber are the plane's most notorious graverobbers.

Kamber and Laurine are Innistrad's most notorious pair of graverobbers, plundering high-value targets with Laurine acting as a diversion while Kamber seizes the valuables. When one scheme led to the tomb of a thousand-year-old vampire, Kamber was transformed before the two could escape. Despite the nagging worry that Kamber’s vampiric nature might one day turn against her, Laurine remains fiercely loyal and the two continue their thievery together.
